name: El Monte City Council Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE
  CITY COUNCIL
  NOTICE OF ADJOURNED REGULAR
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING PURSUANT TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54955

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the El Monte City
Council adjourned its Regular City Council Meeting of
Tuesday, November 16, 2021 to an Adjourned
Regular City Council meeting to be held on Tuesday,
December 14, 2021 at 6:00 p.m. to take place at
11333 Valley Boulevard, El Monte, CA 91731.

POSTED ON Wednesday, November 17, 2021 at
12:35 pm by Griselda Contreras, Chief Deputy City
Clerk/Records Manager
